_comment: Governance profile for the governed-vs-ungoverned benchmark: the deny-by-default tool allowlist + Airlock RASP (enforce) + budget a governed safe-PR agent runs under. The SAME file is read by the fd-evals harness (fd_evals.governed_benchmark) and the real-engine pin (rust/crates/fd-policy/tests/governed_benchmark.rs), so 'blocked %' is measured against one config on both planes. write_file / http_request / search_code are ALLOWED so the injected unsafe actions reach a distinct Airlock/budget layer (RCE matcher, exfil shield, budget cap) rather than short-circuiting at the allowlist; create_pr / git_commit require approval (human-in-the-loop, not auto-executed); delete_repo is denied. Velocity/schema/behavioral-drift layers are out of scope for this per-run measurement.
